name: agent-instructions-setup
description: Initialize AI coding agent instruction files. Creates AGENTS.md as the single source of truth, 7 symlinks covering 9 AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini CLI, Codex, Zed, Antigravity), and scaffolds docs/guide.md and docs/workflow.md. Make sure to use this skill whenever the user wants to initialize a new project for AI-assisted development, bootstrap AGENTS.md, unify instruction files across multiple AI tools, or migrate existing CLAUDE.md / .cursorrules / .windsurfrules into a single AGENTS.md - even if they only mention one tool by name or ask generically about 'AI rules' or 'agent config'.
